brand.name: Atelier Solstice
brand.tagline: Bioclimatic rammed-earth and mass-timber pavilion architecture

slides.headline:
Build low-carbon,
timeless spaces.
slides.subtitle: Modular passive pavilions combining precast rammed-earth walls, cut limestone plinths, and local Douglas fir framing.

slides.left_text: 42 cm compressed-earth load-bearing cores regulating indoor humidity passively year-round.
slides.right_text: Solid Douglas fir vertical louvers calibrated to block summer zenith sun and admit winter light.

slides.headline: Three structural layers joined without concrete

callouts.title: CANTILEVER ROOF & CIRCULAR OCULUS
callouts.desc: 1.85 m solar overhang shading high summer glare while warming the central double-height atrium.

callouts.title: TIMBER COLONNADE & GLAZED CORE
callouts.desc: Fourteen structural Douglas fir fins paired with triple-glazed thermal curtain walls.

callouts.title: STEPPED TRAVERTINE PLINTH & BASIN
callouts.desc: Reversible helical pier foundations isolating earth walls from moisture with LED perimeter reveal.

slides.headline: From laser site scan to turnkey handover in 14 weeks

stages.label: SITE SCAN
stages.title: Topographic lidar and dynamic thermal twin
stages.summary: Millimeter parcel scanning to align orientation, wind corridors, and passive solar gains.
bullets: Drone photogrammetry and geotechnical soil probing
8,760-hour annual thermal comfort simulation
Verified lifecycle carbon baseline prior to permit

stages.label: PREFAB
stages.title: CNC timber joinery and earth block pressing
stages.summary: Weather-proof factory fabrication within 120 km of the build parcel for zero tolerance drift.
bullets: Excavated site clay sieved and stabilized cement-free
Wood-fiber insulated structural Douglas fir cassettes
Factory pre-fitted glazing and concealed MEP conduits

stages.label: DRY ASSEMBLY
stages.title: Quiet crane rigging and immediate weather-tightness
stages.summary: Sequential dry-bolted module lifting cutting neighborhood noise and site waste by 5x.
bullets: Reversible mechanical fasteners for circular reuse
Blower-door airtightness verified below 0.45 ACH
Green roof planting and micro-grid tie-in on day 12
